testcase.name: an empty group gets no chip
taking a channel out of one group leaves it starred when it is in another
a settled heart falls back to the cache, which is why the entry is dropped
the groups a channel is in are its own, not the list's
taking a channel out of its only group empties the heart
one filter at a time, so no screen has to decide which of two wins
an optimistic entry wins over what the cache says, in both directions
